Official FAQ: sale date set by the delinquent tax attorney, not more than once a year; bidders must appear in person and pre-register; list published in the Standard Banner 30–45 days prior; payment day of sale by cash, cashier's check, or personal check; 1-year owner redemption from confirmation at 1% per annum plus reimbursed taxes. Contact 865-397-2404.

auctionPlatform.label: Jefferson County Clerk & Master — courthouse tax sale

47089.auctionFrequency: Not more than once annually; date set by delinquent tax attorney — watch Standard Banner notices
47089.depositRules: Payment required the day of sale by cash, cashier's check, or personal check per Clerk & Master FAQ. Appear in person and register as a bidder before the sale. Confirm any deposit percentage or disqualifiers with the office (865-397-2404) when the list posts.

taxCollector.label: Jefferson County Chancery Court — Clerk & Master (delinquent tax sales)

clerkOfCourt.label: Jefferson County Register of Deeds / Circuit Court resources

47089.survivingLiens: Judicial tax sale subject to 1-year redemption after confirmation. After redemption expires, most junior private liens are cut off if properly joined; federal liens can survive.
47089.quietTitle: Court confirmation helps; quiet title still commonly used when insurers want additional comfort on East Tennessee inventory.

27025.notes: Minnesota tax-forfeited land (deed) county. Chisago County (Center City / North Branch / Twin Cities north-east exurb) Auditor-Treasurer sells parcels after state forfeiture vests title in the State of Minnesota. No fixed auction cadence — signup via Notify Me for sale alerts. Next auction posted for April 8, 2026 (8:30–9:30 AM, Government Center Room 150B, 313 North Main St, Center City). Notice of Tax Forfeit Sale PDF published on county site; local paper notice ~20 days prior. Unsold parcels may be offered following day at appraised price at Auditor-Treasurer discretion. References MNTaxForfeitureSettlement.com surplus claims process. Call 651-213-8500 for amounts due on pending forfeiture parcels.

auctionPlatform.label: Chisago County Auditor-Treasurer — Tax Forfeited Land Sale

27025.auctionFrequency: Irregular — no set schedule; April 8, 2026 auction posted at research time; subscribe to Notify Me
27025.depositRules: Per published Notice of Tax Forfeit Sale — typically payment by cashier's check, money order, or certified check at appointment or by mail as specified (no casual personal checks). Confirm deposit, minimum bid, and same-day payment rules in the current sale packet before attending.

13039.notes: Georgia redeemable-deed county. Camden County (Kingsland / St. Marys / coastal SE Georgia, Kings Bay adjacency) Tax Commissioner conducts ex-officio sheriff tax sales on the first Tuesday of the month at 12:00 noon on the courthouse steps when parcels are levied. Notices published weekly in The Tribune & Georgian for four weeks before sale. County posts Tax Sale and Redemption pages on camdencountyga.gov. 1-year redemption; redemption price includes amount paid plus subsequent taxes paid by purchaser plus statutory premium (commonly 20% first year structure under GA practice — confirm current statute math on county Redemption page). Flood/coastal and military-adjacent DD essential.

auctionPlatform.label: Camden County Tax Commissioner — Tax Sale (ex-officio sheriff)

13039.auctionFrequency: First Tuesday of each month at 12:00 noon when parcels are advertised
13039.depositRules: Typical GA courthouse-steps practice: cash or certified funds the day of sale for taxes, penalties, interest, and costs as advertised. Confirm exact payment and any registration rules with the Tax Commissioner before attending.

13039.quietTitle: Notice/barment under O.C.G.A. Title 48 is the statutory path to strengthen title; many title companies still want quiet title or completed barment before insuring for resale.

28109.notes: Mississippi tax-lien county. Pearl River County (Poplarville / Picayune / New Orleans north fringe) holds the annual tax lien sale online on GovEase beginning the last Monday of August each year, running until all delinquent parcels sell (typically 5–7 days). Online registration opens the first week of August. After sale, owner has two years to redeem through the Chancery Clerk at 1.5% per month interest on the initial lien amount (overbid excluded from redemption principal). End of sale: Tax Collector turns process to Chancery Clerk. Training docs on GovEase MS help site.

auctionPlatform.label: GovEase — Pearl River County Online Tax Sale

28109.auctionFrequency: Annually — last Monday of August, multi-day until parcels clear; registration first week of August
28109.depositRules: Register on GovEase before the sale; complete MS tax-auction training as recommended. Payment methods listed by county include cash, cashier's check, check, money order, and major cards (cards incur separate ~3% convenience fee not paid by the county). Confirm max-bid funding and settlement rules with GovEase and the Tax Collector before August.

39143.notes: Ohio hybrid county. County Sheriff Sales page posts upcoming online dates; prior registration required. Delinquent-tax foreclosure / forfeited-land tracks may differ from mortgage-style judicial sales — read each case caption carefully. Deposit tiers and wire deadlines follow statewide RealAuction practice.

01113.notes: Alabama hybrid tax sale county. Russell County (Phenix City / Columbus GA metro west bank) Revenue Commissioner conducts the annual delinquent tax sale — public notice circulated for a May 5, 2026 sale; contact Revenue Office 334-298-7011. Unlike many AL peers on GovEase, current public materials emphasize local announcement rather than a confirmed third-party online platform — verify whether the cycle is in-person at the courthouse or online before registering. Unsold liens may later appear on Alabama Department of Revenue state inventory transcripts. Confirm elected method (tax lien vs. land sale) for the sale year.

01113.depositRules: Obtain bidder registration and payment rules directly from the Revenue Commissioner (334-298-7011) for the posted sale. If the county uses an online vendor, complete that platform's deposit/funding steps; if in-person, expect cash or certified funds per the local notice. 48323.notes: Texas redeemable-deed county. Confirm sale location, minimum bid, and certified-funds rules before first Tuesday. Border industrial (Eagle Pass port) and floodplain DD essential.

40051.notes: Oklahoma tax-deed (county resale) county. Grady County (Chickasha / south OKC metro fringe) Treasurer holds the statutory annual resale of properties on which the county has held the tax certificate for the statutory period — statewide default is the second Monday in June. Treasurer portal oktaxrolls.com/county/Grady posts tax rolls and June Resale Commissioner notices; office 405-224-5337, 326 W Choctaw, Chickasha. Unlike lien states, investors generally do not buy the certificate at a retail auction first — they bid at the June resale for a deed. Confirm exact 2027 resale date, list, and payment rules with the Treasurer.
